ValidationRule.description: Allows members of the Legal team to change the Owner and Status of Contract Help cases. New team members must have their last names entered in the formula below.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(ISCHANGED( OwnerId ), ISCHANGED( Status ))&& NOT( $Profile.Name = "System Administrator") && NOT( $Profile.Name = "Contract Administration") && NOT( $Profile.Name = "CA Contract Manager") && $RecordType.Name = "Contract Help Request" && OwnerId <> "00G00000006yPO3" && $User.LastName <> "Coan"&& $User.LastName <> "Rawls" && $User.LastName <> "Collins" && $User.LastName <> "Allen" && $User.LastName <> "O'Grady" && $User.LastName <> "Banks" && $User.LastName <> "Lane" && $User.LastName <> "Twiddy" && $User.LastName <> "Stout" && $User.LastName <> "Weithofer" && $User.LastName <> "Pope"
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not authorized to change this Owner or Status field. Please contact sfhelp@rithum.com to request permission to be added to the validation rule for Contract Help case ownership changes.
